attributes.refuted_premises: (1) THE WORK ORDER'S OWN MINIMUM SET IS PARTLY WRONG. work_claim.custodial-3.20260904.v1 names 'critter' among the distance 1-3 TUs to sweep. Measured: game/enemy/critter is 68/84 functions = 16 open, the second-worst NonMatching TU in the image; it is not within 3 of a flip and no section work changes that. The other 13 named TUs are all genuinely in the 1-3 band. (2) 'ALL FOUR DISTANCE-1 TUs OWE SECTIONS' IS FALSE, and so is its opposite: of the six TUs with exactly one open function, FOUR (dcsdrv, pb_frame, dbgtext, mb_camera) print 0 blockers and textorder OK -- one function each is the WHOLE remaining cost -- while sounds_evt and newcam owe two unclaimed sections AND are MISORDERED. The run-51 lesson generalises to 'measure both axes per TU', not to 'assume debt'.
